project_name.justification: The text states: "TDG will acquire from ArcWest a 100% interest in the Oxide Peak mineral claims ('Oxide Peak')..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: "TDG Gold Corp (TSXV:TDG) (the 'Company' or 'TDG') announces that it has entered into a definitive purchase agreement..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company, TDG Gold Corp., is identified as Fletcher Morgan: "Fletcher Morgan, TDG's CEO, commented..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that TDG will acquire a 100% interest: "TDG will acquire from ArcWest a 100% interest in the Oxide Peak mineral claims..."

primary_commodity.justification: The text mentions the potential for copper and gold discoveries, listing copper first: "Oxide Peak provides multiple opportunities for copper-gold porphyry discoveries."

verified_article_link.justification: The article is a press release from TDG Gold Corp. announcing the definitive purchase agreement for the Oxide Peak project, which is the project of interest.

currency.justification: The cash consideration is denoted by '$' and the acquiring company, TDG Gold Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian exchange, implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The agreement includes a cash payment of $100,000: "Under the terms of the Purchase Agreement, in consideration for the Acquisition, TDG will pay ArcWest $100,000..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The value of the share payment is not explicitly stated. Instead, the number of shares and a price per share are available, so amount_of_shares_issued and issued_share_price are populated per the extraction hierarchy.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the payment are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement specifies the number of shares to be issued: "...and will issue to Arcwest 412,031 common shares of TDG (the 'TDG Shares')."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (412,031), but not an explicit price per share for the transaction. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.56'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The 2,050 metres of diamond drilling mentioned was completed under a previous option agreement which has now been terminated, and does not represent a new commitment under the current Purchase Agreement.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The $3.3 million of exploration expenditures mentioned was completed under a previous option agreement which has now been terminated, and does not represent a new commitment under the current Purchase Agreement.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller, ArcWest, retained a 2% NSR as part of the transaction terms: "Additionally, ArcWest will receive a 2% net smelter returns royalty on the Oxide Peak property..."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text specifies the size of the property: "Oxide Peak covers 8,490 hectares of prospective exploration ground..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified in the text: "Oxide Peak covers 8,490 hectares of prospective exploration ground..."

resource_size.justification: The text indicates the project is at an early stage and does not have a defined mineral resource, stating: 'Exploration targets and/or Exploration zones and/or Exploration areas are speculative and there is no certainty that any future work or evaluation will lead to the definition of a mineral resource.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified with its ticker and exchange in the first sentence of the press release: "TDG Gold Corp (TSXV:TDG)".
